title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: Reimbursement for an Out-of-Network Callout
content:
Where the member uses an operator outside the network on a Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan that
requires the network, nothing is dispatched and the member claims reimbursement instead, capped at the
plan's reimbursement ceiling and submitted inside the plan's submission period counted in whole
calendar days from the day of the callout.

### The clause taken apart

| Element | What it comes to |
| --- | --- |
| When it arises | The member used an operator outside the network, on a plan that requires network operators |
| What is dispatched | Nothing |
| What the member has instead | A claim for reimbursement |
| The ceiling | The plan's reimbursement ceiling |
| The period allowed | The plan's submission period, in whole calendar days |
| Where the period is counted from | The day of the callout |

### The submission clock and what settles it

The clock is anchored on the day of the callout, and the comparison is not-later-than: a claim
submitted inside the plan's submission period is in time, and the last day of that period is itself
inside it. What the callout's own record shows carries authority — its reference number, the date of
the callout and how the callout ended — rather than the member's recollection of the date, and the
record consulted is the record of the callout the claim is raised against. The question is settled
before the reimbursement is raised.

| The day the claim is submitted | In time |
| --- | --- |
| Any day up to and including the last day of the plan's submission period, counted in whole calendar days from the day of the callout | Yes |
| The day after that period has run out | No |
